description: Pretrained MiniFASNet presentation-attack-detection models (Silent-Face-Anti-Spoofing). Weights are NOT bundled: run tools/convert_minifas.py (needs torch, separate venv) which writes the .onnx files and fills in sha256 below. Until sha256 values are pinned and the files validate, PAD reports NOT_CONFIGURED / ERROR.
license: Apache-2.0 (believed; NOT verified in the authoring session - confirm LICENSE in the source repo before deployment)
ensemble: mean of the per-model softmax 'real' probabilities (the official project sums the softmax vectors; the mean is the same ordering)

input.scaling: none: float32 values 0..255, not divided by 255
none: float32 values 0..255, not divided by 255
